value.rationale: The originating finite-torus work leaves the number and location of phenotype-mutation optima undetermined. On the natural minimal binary recognition space, the theorem gives a complete continuous-parameter global classification: exactly one nondegenerate optimum, explicit computable bounds, and two counterintuitive comparative statics that are not implied by pointwise source results. This is a useful exact baseline for more complicated finite phenotype networks, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or routine threshold restatement.
